card.name: Words inside lists of adverse effects
card.fires_on: Words that come right after a comma or "or" in a list of effects or findings, such as "profound" before sedation, the start of nystagmus, or the "-na" in anti-nausea. It also fires on a space before a number in a table caption.

modes.label: Profound before sedation
modes.description: The word "profound" in the benzodiazepine and opioid warning list ending in sedation, coma, and death.
modes.example: can increase the risk of hypotension, respiratory depression,<< profound>> sedation, coma, and death.
